description: This file contains utilities for seeding a database with JSON data, including functions to load JSON files, ensure database tables exist, perform upsert operations for roles, competencies, role adjacency, and role competencies, and a main function to orchestrate the seeding process with fallback to minimal data if JSON files are missing.

methods.name: _load_json
methods.description: Loads a JSON array from a specified file in the data directory, handling missing files and non-array JSON structures.

methods.name: _ensure_catalog_tables
methods.description: Creates necessary database tables if they do not exist, supporting idempotent seeding.

methods.name: _upsert_roles
methods.description: Performs upsert operations for role records based on unique code, attempting to preserve IDs if provided.

methods.name: _upsert_competencies
methods.description: Performs upsert operations for competency records based on unique code, preserving IDs if provided.

methods.name: _upsert_role_adjacency
methods.description: Upserts role adjacency relationships based on composite primary key.

methods.name: _upsert_role_competencies
methods.description: Upserts role-to-competency requirement records based on composite primary key.

methods.name: seed_catalog_from_json
methods.description: Main function to seed the database with roles, competencies, adjacency, and mappings from JSON files or default data if files are missing.
